storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Whop Downloader makes it easy to save content from Whop.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any page on Whop, click the extension icon, and the popup shows all detected videos, images, and text posts organized in tabs. Download items individually or use "Download Visible" to grab everything at once.

The extension handles Mux-hosted HLS streams, shadow DOM elements, and multiple content types automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Detects videos, images, and text posts from any Whop page
- Mux player and Mux video element support (HLS to MP4 conversion)
- Bulk download all visible content with one click
- In-page overlay download buttons on video players
- Download queue with up to 3 concurrent downloads
- Real-time download progress in the in-page manager
- Shadow DOM traversal for deeply nested content
- Tabbed popup UI with asset counts and previews
- Dark-themed UI with Whop-style orange-red accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Whop.com and open a course, lesson, or community post
3. Click the extension icon to see detected content
4. Select a tab (Videos, Images, Text) and download — or use "Download Visible" for all

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video from Whop?
faq.answer: Go to any page on Whop.com that contains video content. Click the extension icon, switch to the Videos tab, and click Download on any video. You can also use the overlay button that appears directly on the video player.

faq.question: Can I download images and text too?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects videos, images, and text posts. Use the tabs in the popup to switch between content types and download what you need.

faq.question: What about Mux-hosted videos?
faq.answer: The extension automatically detects Mux players and handles HLS stream conversion. Videos are saved as standard MP4 files.

faq.question: Can I download everything at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Click Download Visible to start downloading all detected items in the active tab (Videos, Images, or Text).

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Files save to your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my content?
faq.answer: Make sure you're on a Whop.com page with visible content. Click Rescan in the popup to re-detect. For videos, press play first so the stream URL becomes available.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
